description: Stormwater Management Concept Information is a dataset listed in Montgomery County open data portal (data.montgomerycountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Montgomery County. A stormwater management concept is a statement or drawing, or both, describing the manner in which stormwater runoff from a proposed development will be controlled to minimize damage to neighboring properties and receiving streams and to also prevent the discharge of pollutants into surface waters. Update Frequency: Daily. Coverage: Montgomery County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Licenses/Permits. Its tags are drainage, water quality, waiver, stormwater, runoff. The table has 38 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-montgomerycountymd-gov-portal.
